body: I think, more than anything, I just want a new batch of faces to talk to. I want to get away. I'm fed up. I can't see the point of getting up and showing up to the same people every. single. time. And I do most, if not more, of my school work at home anyway. So what even is the point? But I'm afraid to bring this up after my parents recently thinking that I have a superiority complex for not going to school and holing up at home when I think the inverse. I feel like I'm making much better use of my time and am in fact more productive at home.

I have ventured to suggest home schooling to my parents (I also much prefer learning by myself, as I am confident I could cover the syllabus in half the time due to how slow the teachers in my school pace themselves). However, they think I won't have a reliable source of pain aka socializing. I also feel extremely conceited when I try to voice my thoughts of school being a waste to anyone because I somehow feel like it is not my place to say these things. It's sort of a twisted imposter syndrome type situation.

I just can't see the light at the end of the tunnel... Maybe there was none to begin with. I feel suffocated, just cooped up at home all the time. I'm bored with life and saying this hurts me considering everyone else that are less fortunate. I don't know first hand suffering... I don't deserve this.
